NFL DFS Wide Receiver Rankings: Week 12 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 29 · 9 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 27, 4:32 PM ET

Jaxon Smith-Njigba is the top-projected wide receiver on the Week 12 DraftKings main slate at 20.7 DraftKings points for $9,100, at San Francisco. Ja'Marr Chase (20.6, $8,900) and Justin Jefferson (17.7, $7,800) are next.

Jakobi Meyers returns the most per dollar among wide receivers projected for at least 9 points: 3.54 projected points per $1,000 at $4,500.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 27, 4:32 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Wide receivers to know in Week 12

Jaxon Smith-Njigba, SEA at SF ($9,100)

Jaxon Smith-Njigba carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 20.7 DraftKings points at $9,100, the 3rd-highest on the entire main slate. That is 0.1 points clear of Ja'Marr Chase. The model gives him 9.0 targets on 25.6 routes. The salary works out to 2.27 projected points per $1,000, 7th of 18 at the position. Across 50,000 simulations Smith-Njigba averaged 20.7 points with a simulated floor of 7.4 and a ceiling of 45.3, and he holds 25% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Seattle is a 2.5-point underdog on the road against San Francisco, with an implied team total of 20.5 in a game totaled at 43.5.

Ja'Marr Chase, CIN vs NO ($8,900)

Ja'Marr Chase projects 2nd at the position with 20.6 DraftKings points at $8,900, 4th on the main slate overall. The model gives him 8.9 targets on 35.6 routes. The salary works out to 2.32 projected points per $1,000, 4th of 18 at the position. Across 50,000 simulations Chase averaged 20.6 points with a simulated floor of 7.7 and a ceiling of 46.1, and he holds 29% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Cincinnati is a 9.5-point favorite at home against New Orleans, with an implied team total of 29 in a game totaled at 48.5.

Justin Jefferson, MIN vs ATL ($7,800)

Justin Jefferson projects 3rd at the position with 17.7 DraftKings points at $7,800. The model gives him 8.1 targets on 26.1 routes. The salary works out to 2.27 projected points per $1,000, 6th of 18 at the position. Across 50,000 simulations Jefferson averaged 17.7 points with a simulated floor of 4.9 and a ceiling of 42.4, and he holds 25% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Minnesota is a 7-point favorite at home against Atlanta, with an implied team total of 24.25 in a game totaled at 41.5.

Value: Jakobi Meyers, JAX vs TEN ($4,500)

Jakobi Meyers projects for 15.9 DraftKings points at $4,500, which works out to 3.54 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 18 wide receivers the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 6.6 targets on 22.2 routes. Across 50,000 simulations Meyers averaged 16.0 points with a simulated floor of 3.3 and a ceiling of 40.6, and he holds 37% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Jacksonville is a 14-point favorite at home against Tennessee, with an implied team total of 31.25 in a game totaled at 48.5.
